title: merge --reviewed reads lane-lint as the join does
why: Main's two lane-lint readers disagree. lint_check (the join) skips a batch integration PR with a green all-jobs rollup, and accepts an older-head PASS when every later commit is a claim (claim_only). reviewed_read (merge --reviewed) takes neither route, so such a PR reads 'no lint' there. Two readers of one verdict, with no stated reason (rule building-one-home-per-capability).
note: Fix: reviewed_read calls the same lint verdict lint_check uses (one home), so both take the rollup skip and claim_only. Red first: a claim-only later commit reads lint PASS in --reviewed. Check change: full review, round 3 net-value test applies. Departs from: main, reviewed_read reads 'no lint' on those two routes.
